description: Unified CyberLibrary search: one query, automatic language, BM25 + neural semantic fusion (RRF), returning the most relevant passages with stable chunk IDs, citations, licenses and source URLs, plus an answerable/confidence signal. When to use: first choice when you do not want to decide between keyword and semantic search. Modes: auto (default, both), keyword (exact terms/names), semantic (paraphrase/theme). Options: lang, limit, snippet_chars. Returns: {query, lang, mode_requested, mode_used, answerable, confidence, corpus_version, results[{chunk_id, score, sources, title, author, chapter, para, citation, url, license, snippet}], next_actions}.

lang.description: Optional language filter, e.g. zh-cn, en.

name: cyberlibrary_search
title: Cyberlibrary Search
